verdict.rationale: cubic documents several of its own export paths in open formats: CSV export of team-member analytics, an Analytics API returning PR-level data, and wiki export as markdown files into the repo. Review configuration also lives in-repo as cubic.yaml, so it stays portable. Nothing documents a complete export of all account data or an offboarding/deletion process, so the 'export all and leave' story is only partly covered. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export (review findings, learnings/memory, chat history, custom agents state), account deletion/offboarding docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of the exports.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can export team member data as CSV from both
cubic exports the wiki as markdown files into a directory in your repo
The Analytics API gives you PR-level data on how many issues were flagged, how many were fixed
`cubic.yaml` lives in the root of your repository and becomes the source of truth for AI review behavior
